what: Logo and title pieces switch on one by one from 8px blur. The flicker type flashes on at brightness 2.4 in .3s, nearly dies out at blur 1.5px and opacity .2 in .1s, goes to brightness 1.6 at .15s and settles at its own brightness at .2s (like a fluorescent lamp or LED switching on). The blur type clears in .57s power1.inOut. Each piece starts at (delay − .7) × .75 (flicker) or × .7 (blur) seconds, and everything plays at 1.9x speed

options.shift: Value to subtract from the delay (s), default .7
options.on: If view, plays when it enters the screen (start defaults to top 80%), if absent, plays right on attach
options.data-delay: Piece property — original delay (s), default shift (immediate)
options.data-look: Piece attribute — with fade it is a surface-blur Type, without it is a blink Type
options.data-lead: Piece property — seconds to advance (original crossing piece .4 × 1.9) = .76)
